analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI remains stuck around the 50-level, failing to break out of neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement in negative territory but remains weak for a confirmed trend reversal. The 5-day volatility of -0.05% indicates a continued sideways trend. ADX at 14.1 suggests no established trend, indicating potential for shock-like moves.
